technical.summary: ANET shows intermediate trend strength (ADX 40.26, EMA 50/200 bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) but lacks near-term momentum confirmation; price weakness below short-term EMAs and negative MACD histogram suggest caution despite longer-term bullish structure.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (322.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational IT revenues, and earnings in 66 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate trend strength (ADX 40.26, EMA 50/200 bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with price near support (31.4283) offers contrarian entry in fear-driven market (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve).
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 322.4, strong dollar), zero fundamental conviction (no insider buying, no institutional signal), negative near-term momentum (MACD negative, price below EMA-9/21, RSI 32.52 unconfirmed), and 66-day earnings event risk create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
